provenance.design: Two builds, one host. Arms interleaved per round with the within-pair order flipped on alternate rounds; the statistic is the median of WITHIN-round ratios plus an exact two-sided sign test. A block design was tried in phase 1 and failed on a contended node, reporting a 1.85x speedup as a 0.81x regression.
provenance.what_is_under_test: The reader-registry seam on the DEFAULT path. Every arm runs reader_limit=None, where nothing is ever evicted or reopened, so the claim is that leasing an Arc from a mutex-guarded map costs nothing measurable against the array index it replaced. Flat is the expected result and the gate; a regression is a finding.
provenance.what_this_is_not: Not the phase's headline, which is resident memory and is captured by measure_reader_registry_rss.py. No arm is bounded: a bounded arm's cost is reopen latency, a function of how many files a plan touches rather than of this change.
provenance.records_are_reduced: Each round is the median over the benchmark's own runs of the named metrics, not a full BenchmarkResult.to_dict().
provenance.written_by_hand: This run predates the script emitting its own provenance; the fields are transcribed from the job's stdout (ab_2951009.out). Later runs get it from the job.
provenance.head_at_publication: The branch head adds c5c067ee (refuse an unverifiable reopen) and c7f8fdf8 (docs) after after_sha. Neither is in the measured path: the refusal can only fire on a reopen, which reader_limit=None never performs, and the one stat it adds is per manifest entry at construction on single-file datasets.
